details.description: Llama 3 8B Instruct is Meta's 8-billion-parameter instruction-tuned model from the original Llama 3 family, released April 18, 2024, sized for efficient deployment on smaller infrastructure while remaining optimized for assistant-like chat. Meta states the model is intended for English only and was tested only in English. Its knowledge cutoff is March 2023, earlier than the 70B model's December 2023 cutoff. AWS Bedrock's model card lists this model's lifecycle as Active.
advantages: Scores 68.4 on MMLU (5-shot), per Meta's model card.
Scores 62.2 pass@1 on HumanEval (0-shot), per Meta's model card.
Scores 79.6 on GSM-8K (8-shot, CoT), per Meta's model card.
Sized for efficient deployment on smaller infrastructure than the 70B model, per AWS Bedrock's model card.
disadvantages: Meta states the model is intended for English only and was tested only in English; use in other languages is listed as out-of-scope.
Knowledge cutoff of March 2023, earlier than the 70B model's December 2023 cutoff, per Meta's announcement.
Scores lower than Meta's Llama 3 70B Instruct on every benchmark Meta reports for this family, e.g. MMLU 68.4 vs 82.0 and MATH 30.0 vs 50.4, per Meta's model card.
Meta's model card does not describe tool-calling or function-calling support, unlike the later Llama 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 releases.
use_cases: Text extraction, classification, rewriting and summarization

sources.title: Introducing Meta Llama 3: The most capable openly available LLM to date

notes: Facts list max_input_tokens as 8000/8192 and max_output_tokens as 2048/8192 across bedrock regional variants; Meta's and AWS Bedrock's model cards state a uniform 8,192-token (8K) context window and 8K max output, consistent with the catalog's larger values. AWS Bedrock's model card (fetched 2026-09-24) lists this model's lifecycle as Active.
